newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's Banque du Sud H1 net up.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's Banque du Sud H1 net up.

text.p: Tunisia's Banque du Sud on Monday said its provisional net profits for the first half of 1996 totalled 4.23 million dinars, up from 4.05 million dinars during the same period last year.
Net profit in 1995 was 9.66 million dinars, up from 9.51 million dinars in 1994.
The state-controlled bank has among its shareholders Italian bank Monte Dei Paschi Di Siena and Tunisian businessman Mzoughi Mzabi.
BS in 1995 raised its capital to 50 million dinars from 30 million dinars. ($=0.96 dinar)
